text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...That should be everything we need, 
right? We'd better head back soon.
Ah...! Cesario-chan.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
What a relief...! To think I'd run into 
someone I know in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san, and Spe-san? What's the 
matter, you two?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Actually, I bumped into Buena 
earlier by chance, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right! Do you have time after this? 
There's a cafe I've been wanting to check 
out!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, with Spe-san...!? Yes, if you'd have 
me, I'd love to!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, I just need to head towards where 
the park is... H-Huh...? Where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Where in the world are we~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
F-For now, why don't we retrace our steps? 
Once we reach the station, it'll be easier 
to navigate... Um, looks like it's this 
way!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Isn't this the exact same place as 
before...!? I-I'm so sorry, Spe-san...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-It's okay! If we join forces, we can 
make it back! I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's why you couldn't find 
your way back to the station.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I've always gotten lost easily. I'm 
so sorry, Spe-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! Same here! As your senior, I 
need to get it together next time...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In that case, shall we head back 
together? Please, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness, we're almost back at the 
academy. Thank you so much, you were a 
huge help...!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
"Oh... hey there, young ladies! How about 
a miraculous power stone? Guaranteed to 
bring good fortune!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...That seems somewhat extravagant for us. 
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on, wait a sec! Uh... well... 
Actually, my mom's sick, and things are 
really tough at home!

text_block_list.name: Buena & Spe
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Mother did...? ! N-No way...!?

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, that's right! If this doesn't 
sell, I won't even be able to buy today's 
medicine...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see, is that so... Understood. I'll buy 
it, that power stone.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, please let me help sell those 
power stones too!"

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
...What?! N-No, you don't have to go that 
far...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It's no trouble at all! If 
it'll cheer Mama up, this is the least I 
can do!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Wh-what an earnest look in your 
eyes...! Sorry, just forget I said 
anything~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Um, where are you going...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ahaha! You don't have to worry at 
all. ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-What's the matter, Cesario-chan?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that... Buena-san and 
Spe-san really look so much alike.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-We look alike? Me and Spe-san...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: D-Do you think so...? ...Fufu, ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! N-No! Saying I'm just like 
Spe-san... I've still got a long way to 
go.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because Spe-san has always been 
straightforward about her dream... No 
matter how many times she was knocked 
down, she got right back up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume like a protagonist, one 
that everyone can't help but love.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? Y-You're praising me way too 
much~!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, because it's the honest truth! If 
anything, I haven't praised you nearly 
enough!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're like that too, Buena-san! You're 
so kind, and such a hard worker! It's way 
too much praise to say we're alike!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You're identical even in ways 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Buena Vista and the 
others. There was quite a lively 
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, Cesario-chan was saying that 
Spe-san and I look just alike...
choice_data_list:
You look like the horse girl you admire? 
That's wonderful!

You look like the horse girl you admire? 
That's wonderful, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, Cesario-chan was saying that 
Spe-san and I look just alike...
choice_data_list:
You look like the horse girl you admire? 
That's wonderful!

You look like the horse girl you admire? 
That's wonderful, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That's true, but... I kind of 
feel all fidgety...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Admiration is a light at the end of the 
road. Reaching it with mere ordinary 
effort is nearly impossible—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us devote ourselves together. 
...So that one day, we may reach what we 
yearn for."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's right! Spe-san's 
brilliant back, always ahead of me— I want 
to keep chasing it forever."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu, right in front of both of you...! 
I-It's so embarrassing~...!

text_block_list.name: Buena & Spe
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, compared to Spe-san, I still have a 
long way to go...! N-No! You're the one 
who's better, Buena-san...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Pfft, ahaha! Then let's just say 
we're both trying our best. Let's hold our 
heads high!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪ Yes, if Spe-san says so!
